title: Settings in JSON
steps: ⌘⇧P, Open default settings (read-only): every setting with its default. Its descriptions are in the schema at `/schema/settings.json`.
Open user settings and add `"editor.fontSize": 20`. A second after you stop typing, every editor's text grows.
Open workspace settings and add `"editor.fontSize": 14`: workspace settings win over user settings.
Keybindings: `"keybindings": [{"key": "Mod-k", "command": "quickOpen"}, {"key": "Mod-s", "command": null}]` makes ⌘K open notes and unbinds ⌘S. ⌘⇧P shows the new shortcuts.
Misspell a setting, such as `"editor.fontsize"`. The status bar says `Settings: 1 problem`; hover it to see which.
